## Context and constraints

Problem, observed facts, user requirements and unresolved assumptions.

## Options

Compare at least two practical alternatives, including maintenance and validation costs.

## Decision and rationale

State what is chosen and why. Proposed decisions are not accepted facts.

## Consequences and validation

Tradeoffs, migration/rollback, test evidence and conditions that trigger reconsideration.
